title: Avoid building wake scan candidates for federation journal operations pages
outcome: Operations-only journal reads avoid cloning and revalidating the wake reservation window while retaining the documented scan observations and read-only behavior.
acceptance: Operations-stream journal reads do not clone or revalidate cached wake candidates, while retaining the documented dispatchScan observations and read-only behavior; focused regressions prove operations pages remain readable with an invalid cached wake candidate and wake-stream candidate validation/classification remains intact.
The combined follow-up input has a passing maintained five-stage full gate and an independent Codex plus Claude read-only review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
